# WriteShort <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
WriteShort:Void stream:Int32, short:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream to write to. |
| `short` | In | Int32 | required | The value to write. |

## Description

Writes a number in 2 bytes, low byte first. Values outside 0 to 65535 wrap around.
